title: Give every stored cell a role through a dry-runnable migration verb
action: Slice 4, D9 (store 4eaf1b71). Ship a migration verb that gives every stored cell a role, since mrs-8 made role required for NEW cells while the store is full of records written before it. Shape, per the plan's answer to its own deferred question: a verb with --dry-run, IDEMPOTENT, reporting its counts before it writes anything. Not lazy-on-read — three counters scan the whole store, so a half-migrated store would misreport. Mapping, per D9: a cell recording tier generation or no tier takes role code; a cell recording tier extraction takes role read; a cell recording tier ceiling takes role code AND KEEPS ITS tier ceiling untouched. That last clause matters — the escalation flag of D5 does not exist yet, it is the NEXT cell, and the 40 percent ration still reads tier ceiling today. Removing or rewriting ceiling here would blind the ration between this cell and the next. Touch role only. COUNTS: the decision recorded 484 / 2 / 20 measured on 2026-08-24. Do not hardcode them and do not assert them — this feature has since added its own cells, so recompute from the store and report what you find. A cell that already carries a role is left exactly as it is; running the verb twice must change nothing the second time, and that is a test, not a hope. Declare the verb in catalog.rs AND in generated/registry_payload.json: mrs-12 (commit ff134363) proved that an undeclared-but-served verb is reported unknown by bee --help --all and has no schema for the CLI-shape guard to validate a call against — do not repeat that. Do NOT run the migration against this repo's live store; the orchestrator will dry-run it and decide when to apply.

truths: The verb reports its counts under --dry-run and writes nothing in that mode
Running it twice changes nothing the second time, pinned by a test rather than asserted in prose
A cell already carrying a role is left byte-identical
Cells recording tier ceiling keep that tier — only role is added
The verb is declared in catalog.rs and registry_payload.json, and registry_dispatch stays green
No count from the 2026-08-24 decision is hardcoded; the verb computes from the store it is given
